channel.title: Pier & Point · UCSF Medical Center at Mission Bay
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for UCSF Medical Center at Mission Bay (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · UCSF Medical Center at Mission Bay: UCSF Medical Center at Mission Bay now uses its Assessor lot lines.
item.description: UCSF Medical Center at Mission Bay now uses its Assessor lot lines. Source: DataSF Assessor parcels (acdm-wktn), lots 8723008, 3992003, 8724001 and 8729001.

item.title: Correction · UCSF Medical Center at Mission Bay: The UCSF hospital's $1.52 billion cost is the contractor DPR's stated project value, not a final audited cost. The UC Regents' 2008 presentation gave a different total, a $1.686 billion budget, and the two are not reconciled.
item.description: The UCSF hospital's $1.52 billion cost is the contractor DPR's stated project value, not a final audited cost. The UC Regents' 2008 presentation gave a different total, a $1.686 billion budget, and the two are not reconciled. Source: DPR Construction, UCSF Medical Center at Mission Bay (https://www.dpr.com/projects/ucsf-medical-center-at-mission-bay); UC Regents, September 2008 (https://regents.universityofcalifornia.edu/regmeet/sept08/j1pp.pdf).
item.source: DPR Construction, UCSF Medical Center at Mission Bay (https://www.dpr.com/projects/ucsf-medical-center-at-mission-bay); UC Regents, September 2008 (https://regents.universityofcalifornia.edu/regmeet/sept08/j1pp.pdf)

item.title: Correction · UCSF Medical Center at Mission Bay: The opening date cited only ucsf.edu; it now cites DPR's project page, which says the 289-bed, six-story, 878,000 sq ft, $1.52 billion facility opened for patients on February 1, 2015, and the record's opening and cost entries cite DPR alongside the UCSF news post (which blocks automated fetches). The '10 years of planning and 5 years of construction' split is not in DPR, which says 'over a decade of planning, design and construction', so the summary and notes now say that. The architect credit now follows McDonough's project page (Stantec, formerly Anshen+Allen, and William McDonough + Partners as architects) and DPR (Stantec Architecture), the hospital's use cites McDonough's page, the address cites OSM, the map caveat's parcel example now reads 675 Mission Bay Blvd, about 12.2 acres, and the Wikimedia aerial credit names only the Commons username Firstcultural.

item.title: Planned · UCSF Medical Center at Mission Bay: UC Regents Committee on Grounds and Buildings certifies the project EIR, approves LRDP Amendment #3, and approves the design, site plan and financial plan for the UCSF Medical Center at Mission Bay -- this hospital specifically, per the item's own site plan (Attachment, p.15) laying out the hospital buildings, parking and phase boundary; the September 17, 2008 certification date is corroborated by a later (2009) Regents item recounting it (Sep 17, 2008)
